name: feature.walkthroughs.nodes
description: Walkthroughs feature node pack — reads over ctx.features.walkthroughs (ADR 0378): the launchable walkthrough list and the tenant's progress, so an onboarding/heartbeat workflow can gate a branch on walkthrough state (the engine's ui.walkthrough.* step nodes are HOST-registered suspend primitives by design — this pack wraps only the ctx READ surface). role:action (recorded).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Walkthroughs: List
nodes.description: Lists the walkthroughs the tenant can launch over ctx.features.walkthroughs.listWalkthroughs. Output: { walkthroughs }.

nodes.label: Walkthroughs: Progress
nodes.description: Reads the tenant's walkthrough progress over ctx.features.walkthroughs.walkthroughProgress (per-user rows for the run's acting user; legacy tenant fallback). Output: { progress }.
